steps.title: Suit Up & Countdown
steps.instruction: Apna space helmet pehno aur countdown bolo: 3.. 2.. 1.. Blast off!
steps.speech: Captain! Rocket me fuel bhar gaya hai. Helmet lagao aur mere saath bolo: 3... 2... 1... ZOOM! Rocket ud gaya aasmaan me!

steps.title: Zero Gravity Moonwalk
steps.instruction: Hum Chandamama par pahunch gaye! Yahan gravity nahi hai, hawa me tairo!
steps.speech: Captain, hum Chandamama par land kar gaye! Wow, yahan hum hawa me balloon ki tarah ud rahe hain! Slow motion me jump lagao!

steps.title: Plant the Victory Flag
steps.instruction: Moon par flag lagao aur Mission Success bolo!
steps.speech: Mission Accomplished Captain! Aapne Moon par flag laga diya! You are the braves astronaut ever! +2 Stars award!

steps.title: Board the Safari Jeep
steps.instruction: Jeep me baitho aur horn bajao: Beep Beep!
steps.speech: Chalo Explorer! Safari jeep start ho gayi hai: Vrooom! Jungle me ghus rahe hain, apne binoculars aankhon par lagao!

steps.title: Spot the Lion King
steps.instruction: Wo dekho ped ke peeche Sher so raha hai! Zor se dahado: Roaaar!
steps.speech: Ssshh... Aage dekho! Jungle ka raja Sher aaram kar raha hai! Chalo use daraye bina sher ki aawaz nikalo: Roaaar!

steps.title: Feed Banana to Elephant
steps.instruction: Haathi Raja ko mitha kela khilao!
steps.speech: Haathi Raja ne soond utha kar bola Thank You! Safari Expedition complete! You are a certified Wildlife Master! +2 Stars!

steps.title: Mix the Chocolate Batter
steps.instruction: Bowl me flour, milk aur chocolate dalkar gol-gol ghumao!
steps.speech: Chef hat pehno! Bowl me chocolate daal di hai. Apni chammach se gol-gol ghumao: Chhan chhan chhan! Batter ready!

steps.title: Bake in the Magic Oven
steps.instruction: Oven me rakho aur magic spell bolo: Ting Ting!
steps.speech: Magic oven me cake phool raha hai! Khushboo aa rahi hai yummy chocolate ki! 3 seconds wait... Ting! Cake bahar aa gaya!

steps.title: Decorate with Strawberries
steps.instruction: Cake ke upar strawberry aur sprinkles lagao!
steps.speech: Wow! Itna sundar aur tasty cake! Sabhi bache taaliyan bajao! MasterChef Badge unlock ho gaya! +2 Stars!
